subject: EOQ conversion accelerator — proposed one-time credit & trial extension
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@clearmap.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ conversion accelerator — proposed one-time credit & trial extension

Hi Ellen,

Congrats on the positive results from the pilot — usage and quality look promising. We want to give Clearmap.ai a small push to convert before quarter close. Quick proposal: a one-time $6,000 service credit applied to the first invoice when you convert, plus a 30-day trial extension so the team can finalize integration timing.

Why this amount: your team peaked at 150k tokens/day during evaluation and the projection we ran shows a near-term $55k ARR expansion if you convert this quarter. The credit helps remove procurement friction and gives you runway to validate volume.

Attachments: I’m sending the trial usage export so you can see the hit patterns (clearmap_trial_usage_report.csv). If this looks good to you, can you confirm acceptance by end of day Tuesday? I’ll route the credit through our sales ops and get a short amendment to the SOW for signatures.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0131

--
Attachment: clearmap_trial_usage_report.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Ellen Park <ellen@clearmap.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ conversion accelerator — proposed one-time credit & trial extension

Ben,

Thanks — that sounds reasonable and timely. Team is aligned on the credit + 30-day extension. A couple quick asks before we greenlight:
- Can you confirm the credit will be applied as a line item on the first invoice (not a future-month rebate)?
- Any constraints on data retention / logs for our security team during the extension window?

If you can confirm those two items I’ll get our procurement to proceed. We aim to have a PO or signature by Thu EOD.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of ML Engineering, Clearmap.ai
ellen@clearmap.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: EOQ conversion accelerator — Clearmap credit request (need approval)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Clearmap response. Quick summary and ask:

Summary: Clearmap wants the $6,000 credit applied to first invoice + 30-day trial extension. Procurement expects PO/signature by Thu EOD.

Why approve:
- Pipeline: ACV likely $55k ARR if converted this quarter.
- Cost: $6k is <12% of first-year ARR and keeps the customer in our committed tier.
- Risk: Low; short-term credit, standard T&Cs.

Requested approval: $6,000 one-time credit + authorize sales ops to generate amendment. Also confirm we can apply credit as invoice line item and provide temporary extended logs retention at standard enterprise retention level while the extension is active.

I’ve attached the usage report and a draft credit terms PDF for review. If you need lower, I can live with $4k but will ask for expedited signature.

Thanks — Ben

--
Attachment: credit_terms-draft.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EOQ conversion accelerator — Clearmap credit request (need approval)

Ben — thanks for the context. I approve up to $4,000 from quota-level discretionary credits. Rationale: deal looks healthy and $4k should be enough to remove friction. If you need the full $6k, Karthik will have to approve the $2k stretch (management discretionary).

Also: sales ops should apply the credit as an invoice line item and include credit expiration terms in the amendment. For the logs retention ask, ask infra/security to confirm — my assumption is we can enable enterprise retention for the 30-day window without special exceptions.

Marissa
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa — I approve the remaining $2,000 (final approval to reach $6,000). Conditions:
- Sales ops to record credit as a one-time invoice line item and include an expiry clause (credit applied to first invoice within 60 days of conversion).
- Finance to review credit accounting; Sales Ops please copy finance@redwood.ai when you create the amendment.
- Ben: please send the final amendment to Ellen and confirm DocuSign link creation; plan: 30-day extension + $6k one-time credit.

Good work — prioritize getting the PO by Thu.
